name: Tyr's Hand Abbey
summary: In Tyr's Hand, the Scarlet Crusade keeps the abbey for worship and study. The fortified city stands in the southeastern Eastern Plaguelands, where the abbey supports the grand Scarlet Basilica.

sections.title: Sanctuary of the Zealots
sections.body: Tyr's Hand Abbey gives the Scarlet Crusade a quieter place for worship and martial teaching. The Scarlet Basilica rises over the city's skyline, while the abbey follows a design familiar from Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. Its Main Hall stands between the Hall of Arms and Library Wing. Though horrors plague the land, the Crusade keeps the abbey in careful repair and guards its cloisters fiercely from outsiders.

faq.q: What is Tyr's Hand Abbey used for?
faq.answer: The abbey gives the Scarlet Crusade in Tyr's Hand a place to worship, live, train, and study. The grand Basilica hosts major ceremonies, while the Hall of Arms and Library Wing support its other work.

faq.q: Why does it look like Northshire Abbey?
aliases: why does it look like northshire
faq.answer: Northshire Abbey and Tyr's Hand Abbey follow familiar Lordaeron and Stormwind designs for Holy Light monasteries. Each has a main assembly hall, a martial training wing, and an archive of sacred texts.

faq.q: Who controls the abbey right now?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade controls the abbey. Crusader soldiers, priests, and paladins fiercely defend Tyr's Hand, attacking anyone who does not bear their colors.

angles.text: For a holy warrior, Tyr's Hand Abbey shows how the Silver Hand's legacy has been corrupted. A once-hallowed place of prayer now serves fanaticism and bloodlust.
The Library Wing holds remnants of classical Holy Light doctrine, preserved through the Scarlet Crusade's skewed and obsessive view.
